scoring_justification: Minority DOS at EF is recomputed from the submitted energy-DOS arrays; magnetic moments are compared to paper-reported values with tolerance.

outputs.description: Total magnetic moment of ordered Co2TiSn, compared to a fixed hidden gold value with tolerance.

required.energy: array of float (eV, relative to Fermi level)

outputs.description: Minority-spin DOS of ordered Co2TiSn; the checker recomputes the DOS at the Fermi level (value at energy=0) and verifies it is below the half-metallic threshold.
Total magnetic moment of disordered Co2TiSn, compared to a fixed hidden gold value with tolerance.

required.energy: array of float (eV, relative to Fermi level)

outputs.description: Minority-spin DOS of disordered Co2TiSn; the checker recomputes the DOS at the Fermi level and verifies it is below the half-metallic threshold.

output_contract.notes: All output files are used to verify the main computational claims: the magnetic moment of the ordered structure and the persistence of the half-metallic gap in both ordered and disordered cases. The checker recomputes the minority-spin DOS at the Fermi level from the raw energy-DOS arrays and compares the submitted magnetic moments to the paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold magnetic moment for ordered and disordered structures
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: WIEN2K GGA moment for ordered Co2TiSn = 2.00 μ_B. The disordered structure is expected to retain half-metallic character with a moment close to 2.00 μ_B.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken directly from paper reported value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the paper's reported value; not fabricated.

hidden_assets.purpose: threshold for minority-spin DOS at EF to qualify as half-metallic
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper states minority gap is retained and DOS at EF is negligible (gap ~0.5 eV); a value < 0.1 states/eV/f.u. is a conservative condition.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Set to 0.1 states/eV/f.u. based on physical expectation of a half-metal.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from physical requirement of a gap; a correct DFT calculation preserving half-metallicity will give DOS at EF much smaller than threshold.
